verdict.rationale: Vue's official releases page states that releases follow Semantic Versioning. It also documents a deprecation policy: deprecated features keep working in minor releases and are removed only in the next major release, and a Vue 2 migration guide exists. Missing for 10: semver is explicitly not guaranteed for TypeScript definitions, which may break between minors, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration that the deprecation policy is honored in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: Vue releases follow Semantic Versioning with a few edge cases.
Deprecated features will continue to work, and will be removed in the next major release after it entered deprecated status.
We may ship incompatible changes to TypeScript definitions between minor versions.
